title: 😂 “We treat forgiveness like Wi-Fi — free to connect, but someone else always pays the bill.”
paragraphs: 😂 “We treat forgiveness like Wi-Fi — free to connect, but someone else always pays the bill.”
Ever noticed how easy it is to “forgive” when you’re not the one footing the emotional data plan? 💸💔
Forgiveness is powerful… but it’s not free. Someone always absorbs the cost — love, patience, pride, peace.
Before you reconnect to that same network, maybe check the password: Boundaries. 💬

“Bear with each other and forgive one another if any of you has a grievance against someone. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.”
— Colossians 3:13 (NIV)
